record.question: Volume 3 of ICD-10 is divided into three sections. Section II is the _______ .
options: List all the terms classifiable to chapter XIX and chapter XXI
Index of external causes of morbidity and mortality
record.explanation: Answer B: Index of external causes of morbidity and mortality. ICD-10 Volume 3, Section II is the index of external causes of morbidity and mortality. Reference: https://icd.who.int/browse10/2019/en. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
